status_reason: preregistered 2026-09-25 before any real-graph run. The odour-vs-air avoidance gates are now verified: wild-type flies avoid OCT and MCH against air at the training dilutions in Li 2013 Fig. 1I (a table, read exactly), and in four other labs from 1e-3 to undiluted odour (Akalal 2006, Liu & Davis 2009, Iliadi 2018, LaFerriere 2011). Barth 2014's slight attraction was against a mineral-oil arm, not air. The model's arm without odour is air, so Li's comparison is the matching one. The concentration mapping is left as declared (DoOR consensus scale 1): the gates test only the sign, which holds at every published dilution from 1e-3 to neat. No numeric naive OCT/MCH split exists (343 open-access texts scanned), so the balance stays report-only. Tully & Quinn 1985 full text is still unreadable (abstract only). Science choices were delegated to the project's Claude sessions by the owner (2026-09-25).
summary: Naive T-maze choice at the choice point, before any learning: OCT vs MCH should be balanced, and each odour vs air should be avoided.

stimulus.design: one fly at the choice point, arm A left and arm B right, then reciprocal (swapped); relative concentration 1 = the DoOR consensus scale
stimulus.literature_match: T-maze: ~100 flies per trial, 2 min choice, reciprocal half-PIs (Li 2013 methods); OCT 1.5e-3 and MCH 1e-3 v/v there. The model's concentration is the DoOR consensus scale 1 (not mapped to a dilution); the gated sign holds from 1e-3 to undiluted. The body and the maze geometry are not simulated (roadmap P2/P3).

encoder.default_spontaneous_basis: median of the Hallem 2006 spontaneous rates of 24 Ors (1.0-47.0 Hz), for glomeruli without a Hallem value
encoder.r_max_basis: engineering scale for DoOR (0-1 per receptor): Hallem 2004 via DoOR gives 245 spikes/s for Or85b to OCT; not a fitted value
encoder.contralateral_basis: declared design choice: maximal lateralisation at the choice point; no verified value
encoder.rate_to_drive: validation.paradigms.tmaze_odor.drive_for_rate: inverse of the resting LIF rate for the declared engine constants
encoder.table_source: validation/specs/sources/door2_orn_responses_oct_mch_bza.json (DoOR.data db323a4). Units with no single glomerulus dropped; duplicate units in one glomerulus averaged; a missing odour entry means no DoOR data and is treated as no evoked response.

decoder.rule: choice = side with more DNa02 spikes over the decision window (ipsilateral steering); tie = no choice, excluded from the PI

seed_role: encoder per-cell noise; each seed is one fly tested in both side assignments

analysis.PI: PI(a) = (choices of a - choices of b) / choosers, resampled by seed

gates.claim: More than half the trials end in a choice (otherwise the PI is not informative).
gates.basis: design precondition; not a literature value

gates.claim: Naive flies avoid OCT against air (PI for OCT below 0).
gates.basis: published direction against air: wild type at the training dilutions (OCT 1.5e-3, MCH 1e-3 v/v): Li 2013 Fig. 1I (table) w1118 (iso1CJ) avoidance index OCT 54.92 +/- 3.43, MCH 58.33 +/- 6.79 (SEM, N ~6-10); at 10x: OCT 71.96, MCH 74.66. Also Akalal 2006 Table 1 (OCT 0.66-0.78, MCH 0.62-0.84), Liu & Davis 2009 Table 1 (GH146/+ OCT 0.616, MCH 0.621, n = 8), Iliadi 2018 Table 1 (Canton S OCT 56.55, MCH 53.11; N = 6), LaFerriere 2011 Table 1 (undiluted, CS: OCT 12.7, MCH 20.6). Conflict recorded: Barth 2014 Fig. 1B (read from figure) Canton-S vs a MINERAL-OIL arm at 1:500 OCT and 1:750 MCH: about +0.21 and +0.24 (attraction); the model's comparison arm is air, as in Li 2013. Only the sign is gated (the decoder gain is not a fit). Sign: this spec's PI(a) = (a - b)/choosers, so avoidance is PI < 0 (Li's index = -100 x this PI).

gates.claim: Naive flies avoid MCH against air.
gates.basis: published direction against air: wild type at the training dilutions (OCT 1.5e-3, MCH 1e-3 v/v): Li 2013 Fig. 1I (table) w1118 (iso1CJ) avoidance index OCT 54.92 +/- 3.43, MCH 58.33 +/- 6.79 (SEM, N ~6-10); at 10x: OCT 71.96, MCH 74.66. Also Akalal 2006 Table 1 (OCT 0.66-0.78, MCH 0.62-0.84), Liu & Davis 2009 Table 1 (GH146/+ OCT 0.616, MCH 0.621, n = 8), Iliadi 2018 Table 1 (Canton S OCT 56.55, MCH 53.11; N = 6), LaFerriere 2011 Table 1 (undiluted, CS: OCT 12.7, MCH 20.6). Conflict recorded: Barth 2014 Fig. 1B (read from figure) Canton-S vs a MINERAL-OIL arm at 1:500 OCT and 1:750 MCH: about +0.21 and +0.24 (attraction); the model's comparison arm is air, as in Li 2013. Only the sign is gated (the decoder gain is not a fit). Sign: this spec's PI(a) = (a - b)/choosers, so avoidance is PI < 0 (Li's index = -100 x this PI).

reported.claim: Naive OCT vs MCH PI and its 95% CI, reported as a calibration check of the relative odour concentration (not gated).
reported.basis: REPORTED, NOT GATED (decision 2026-09-24): NOT a biological target: labs adjust the relative OCT/MCH concentrations until naive flies split ~50:50 ('Relative concentrations of OCT and MCH were adjusted such that naive flies distributed themselves 50:50 in the T maze', Goodwin 1997; same in Akalal 2006). No paper read reports a numeric naive split. In the model both odours are at DoOR scale 1, so this gate tests the encoder's concentration choice, not the fly. Tolerance is a judgement. 2026-09-25: no numeric naive OCT vs MCH split for wild type was found in 343 open-access full texts (only 'adjusted ... 50:50' statements, e.g. PMC2813723, PMC4928101, PMC5440665); Tully & Quinn 1985 full text unreadable.

decision_rule: Behaviour PASS iff every gate passes. Physiology PASS iff every check lies in its bound. Verdict PASS iff both pass on a confirmatory run (real graph, this spec committed and unchanged, these seeds, clean tree); PASS_PROVISIONAL if any gating value is marked unverified; FAIL if any gate or check fails; INCONCLUSIVE if one cannot be evaluated. Full rule: validation/harness.py VERDICTS.
